_comment: Assets carried over from the v0.1.4 oracle, split by whether v0.2 still ships them byte-identically.
The theme round deliberately changed three page assets and added the site's living-background
renderer, so the old 'every asset matches the oracle' claim is no longer true and must not be
asserted. What remains true is recorded under `unchanged` and still checked digest-for-digest;
each divergence carries the reason it happened, so the difference is evidence rather than drift.

app.js.reason: Every action gated on window.confirm silently did nothing: WKWebView implements no JavaScript dialogs, so confirm() returns false without drawing. That killed create-with-relay, start-public-relay, use-my-own-address, revoke-member and withdraw-standing-consent, leaving the two-Mac join path unreachable with no error. Those five sites now await an in-page <dialog id="ask-dialog">.

index.html.reason: Adds the ask dialog markup, the site's #page-mycelium / #hyphae canvases for the living background, its module boot script, and drops the pre-ruling-25 page subtitle 'macOS A13 hackathon demo' in favour of 'local swarm demo'.

style.css.reason: Adopts the site's dark Green token set (ground #010301, ink #e7f2e3, accent #58f56a, art tokens --strand/--glow/--core), Fraunces for h1-h3 via the embedded woff2, and the layout rules the background renderer needs (.page-mycelium, .page-mycelium-field, .mycelium-breath, .hero-art).

mycelium-boot.js.source: app-local: boots createHero/createField, dark Green only (no hue or theme switch)

app_icon.source: v0.1.4 Mycelium A13 Demo.app/Contents/Resources/icon-windowed.icns (APP-FILES.sha256 of the published zip; certified f4e366e9 package)
